patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width content blocks and split layouts, often with text on the left and a graphic or image on the right, maintaining a clear visual hierarchy.
Headings frequently use a vibrant orange underline for emphasis, creating a consistent brand accent across key titles.
A distinctive deep purple (#320b42) is used as a primary brand color for backgrounds and prominent text, contrasted with bright white and a vivid light blue for calls to action.

The primary navigation bar transforms from transparent to a solid white background and becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after initial scroll. The hero section exhibits a subtle parallax effect, where the mountain background scrolls slower than the foreground content.
Illustrative line-art graphics are consistently used to introduce and visually represent content sections, such as the phone graphic for 'How it works' and the detailed city/car scene in the footer.

technique_notes: The navigation bar transitions its background color and fixes its position to the top of the viewport once the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle slide-up or fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scrolling experience.
Illustrative graphics, likely implemented with Lottie, are integrated throughout the page to add visual interest and explain concepts without relying on static images.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, lighter subheadings and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are applied consistently to buttons and card-like elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing overall, with an airy hero section and distinct vertical rhythm between content blocks, becoming denser in feature grids and FAQ sections.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep purple and vibrant orange accent, combined with playful, detailed line-art illustrations, creates a unique and approachable brand identity that stands apart from typical financial service designs. The orange underline on headings is a simple yet effective branding element.
